statement.excerpt: Their seemingly magic talent at prediction across a huge range of contents masks their complete inability to do the ordinary job of every personal assistant: infer explicit meanings and act on them.
statement.document_title: Three ideas from linguistics that everyone in AI should know

our_interpretation: Read the categorical sentence together with the explicit concession that language models can participate in action workflows.
An ordinary functional test asks whether the model maps a user's intention to an explicit executable operation and carries out the requested action.
A demonstration using a separate grounding or action-selection system is relevant but does not automatically refute the qualified standalone claim.

The target is capabilities available as of 22 June 2022. No beginning or regular reporting interval is supplied; earlier demonstrations of then-existing models are relevant, while later-created agents are outside scope.
criteria.support_condition: Direct evaluations establish that then-current standalone models cannot perform the specified intent-to-action function, rather than merely showing occasional failures.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A documented contemporaneous demonstration succeeds at the specified function within the standalone scope, with the model's contribution distinguished from additional semantic interpretation, grounding and execution components.

Codex generated functionally correct programs from docstrings under a repeated-sampling evaluation. This bears on translating descriptions into executable operations, but the benchmark does not demonstrate the complete standalone assistant workflow.

public_payload.what_would_resolve: A contemporaneous demonstration or retrospective test of a historical model that documents intent interpretation, operation generation and execution, together with a defensible specification of what counts as the model acting by itself.
